headline: Japan asks Peru to strengthen critical mineral supply chains amid arbitrary restrictions
summary: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi asked Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori to reinforce critical mineral supply chains. She cited arbitrary export restrictions imposed by third parties.
why: Critical minerals such as copper and lithium are inputs for electronics, batteries and industrial production, so supply disruptions affect manufacturers and commodity markets.
original_headline: Japón pide a Perú reforzar cadenas de suministro de minerales críticos ante restricciones arbitrarias
